notes.gross_output: Native MARIO X for IOTs and Xc for SUTs, summed over producing nodes. Gross output includes intermediate production at multiple stages and is not GDP.
notes.domestic_use: Domestic-origin use within the same native region only: matching origin and destination regions in Z and Y (IOT) or U and Yc (SUT). Intermediate and final uses enter once; signed source adjustments are retained.
notes.final_demand: Final demand by consumer region from Y (IOT) or Yc (SUT). Domestic and Imported identify the supplying row region relative to that consumer. A shared SNA category vocabulary is used; native combined categories are never split or duplicated. Households + NPISH combines the observed household and NPISH source columns where separately supplied.
notes.value_added_footprint: Reviewed value added generated by domestic and foreign producers to meet final demand in the selected consumer region. Native direct coefficients retain production origins before MARIO calc_m_from_z solves the system. Multiplication by Y/Yc retains final-consumer columns; no full inverse is constructed.
notes.ghg_footprint: Allocable GHG supported by final demand in the consumer region, plus supplied direct final-user emissions once. MARIO calc_ghg uses the reviewed source characterisation, and calc_f_from_z retains production origins before multiplying by Y/Yc. Direct accounts and upstream requirements outside the representable final-demand boundary stay quantified by production origin. EXIOBASE: mass-reported gases use EDGAR-compatible AR5 GWP100 (CH4=28). HFC/PFC already in source CO2eq retain their original characterisation; its IPCC basis is not independently verified. Production accounts and EDGAR territorial totals have different boundaries.
notes.value_added_trade: Upstream value added embodied in signed gross intermediate and final-use crossings. Domestic and Foreign identify value added generated inside or outside the exporting native region. Total includes both and can closely match gross monetary trade in balanced systems. Repeated border crossings can count the same value added again; this is not value-added exports measured by ultimate foreign final absorption.
notes.ghg_trade: Upstream production GHG embodied in signed gross intermediate and final-use crossings. Repeated border crossings can count the same emissions again. Direct final-user emissions and unrepresented production accounts are not allocated to traded output. EXIOBASE: mass-reported gases use EDGAR-compatible AR5 GWP100 (CH4=28). HFC/PFC already in source CO2eq retain their original characterisation; its IPCC basis is not independently verified. Production accounts and EDGAR territorial totals have different boundaries.
